name: commdgi
reference: Zhang, Hu, He, Wang. CommDGI: Community Detection Oriented Deep Graph Infomax. CIKM 2020.

upstream.note: The Encoder/Summarizer/corruption/cluster_net (model.py) and DeepGraphInfomax (DGI.py) are imported unchanged; the patch is two compat fixes (networkx from_numpy_array, sklearn multi_class) off our driver's path. Training is run_commdgi.py on the shared harness, not the authors' train.py.

hidden.doc: Hidden dimensionality of the DGI encoder. Paper uses 512. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

clustertemp.doc: Softmax temperature for the differentiable k-means cluster assignments.
